name: PromptRobust
description: PromptRobust is a robustness benchmark designed to measure large language models' resilience to adversarial prompts. It evaluates the impact of adversarial textual attacks at multiple levels—character, word, sentence, and semantic—across diverse tasks including sentiment analysis, natural language inference, reading comprehension, machine translation, and math problem-solving.
typical_sota_score: varies widely by task and attack strength; typically 40–90% accuracy depending on dataset and adversary (often much lower under strong adversarial prompts)
reputation: A relatively new robustness benchmark from the adversarial prompting literature; it is cited as a useful evaluation set but is not yet a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Includes adversarial prompts crafted to mimic plausible user errors; covers 8 tasks and 13 datasets.
